name: Menu
description: Drops a list of actions below a trigger, driveable entirely by keyboard.

when: Actions that do not fit in the toolbar
Related actions that read better grouped
whenNot: Picking a value for a form (use Select)
Moving between pages or views (use Tabs, Header.NavMenu or Sidebar)
One of a few visible choices (use RadioGroup)
guidelines: Group related actions and separate the rest
Show the keyboard shortcut where one exists
Mark destructive actions with tone="danger": the label turns danger ink, the highlight stays neutral
A chosen state is a Menu.CheckboxItem or a Menu.RadioItem, never a plain item with a mark
Raise the row cap with Menu.Content maxVisibleItems, never by setting --fui-popup-viewport-rows in CSS
Past a dozen rows, reach for Command instead
Nest at most one level of submenu
Pass render={<Button />} to Menu.Trigger to use a library control
accessibility: Full keyboard navigation with arrow keys
Focus returns to trigger on close
ArrowRight opens submenus, ArrowLeft closes them

examples.name: With Radio Items
examples.description: A choice of one: the chosen row carries the check and the other rows keep its column.
examples.code:
<Menu>
  <Menu.Trigger render={<Button variant="soft" />}>Sort</Menu.Trigger>
  <Menu.Content>
    <Menu.RadioGroup defaultValue="updated">
      <Menu.RadioItem value="updated">Last updated</Menu.RadioItem>
      <Menu.RadioItem value="name">Name</Menu.RadioItem>
    </Menu.RadioGroup>
    <Menu.Separator />
    <Menu.Item>Reset view</Menu.Item>
  </Menu.Content>
</Menu>

examples.name: Link Trigger
examples.description: render lets a link open it.

relations.note: Use Select for form field selection
Use Popover for rich non-action content

propsSummary: modal: boolean - blocks page interaction while open (default: true)
Menu.Trigger render: element - render a library control or a link as the trigger
Menu.Content side: top|bottom|left|right (default: bottom); align: start|center|end (default: start); loading: boolean - busy at once, a spinner row after a second (default: false)
Menu.Content maxVisibleItems: number - max visible rows before scrolling, half of the next row shows as a scroll hint (default 4)
Menu.Item onSelect: (event) => void - selection callback receives the click event
Menu.Item tone: neutral|danger - danger colours the ink only (default: neutral)
Menu.Item icon: node; shortcut: string - leading icon and trailing shortcut (tabular figures)
Menu.CheckboxItem checked/defaultChecked/onCheckedChange - a toggle row with a check
Menu.RadioGroup value/defaultValue/onValueChange + Menu.RadioItem value - a choice of one with a check
Checkable rows make every row reserve the indicator column
Menu.Submenu + Menu.SubmenuTrigger - one level of nesting, chevron caret
